summary: Director of Information Technology with extensive experience in networking, troubleshooting, and customer relations, seeking a leadership role to leverage expertise in IT infrastructure, security, and budget management.

experience.title: Director of Information Technology
responsibilities: Served as primary IT liaison for the organization.
Supported over 1,000 users across multiple locations.
Managed vendor relationships and negotiated contracts.
Implemented MPLS network and led its deployment.
Established IT governance framework and policies.
Reduced IT operating costs through strategic budgeting.
Produced regular IT performance reports for senior leadership.

experience.title: Network Engineer / I.T. Manager
responsibilities: Supervised IT and help‑desk teams.
Achieved budget reductions while maintaining service levels.
Designed and deployed security solutions, including firewalls and IDS.
Oversaw data center operations and network infrastructure.
Managed enterprise LAN/WAN, VoIP, and MPLS networks.
Documented network configurations and troubleshooting procedures.
Conducted research on emerging networking technologies.

experience.title: Network Administrator / Help Desk Manager
responsibilities: Provided technical expertise for network and help‑desk issues.
Implemented security policies and performed vulnerability assessments.
Managed network operations for LAN/WAN and data center.
Configured and maintained Cisco UC systems (Call Manager, Unity, Jabber).
Produced KPI reports and coordinated with other IT functions.
Ensured interoperability of network devices and VPN solutions.

experience.title: Help Desk Analyst
responsibilities: Supported over 1,000 Taco Bell locations with POS and network issues.
Logged and tracked support tickets using Remedy.
Utilized Putty for remote troubleshooting.

experience.title: Help Desk Support / IT Technician / Network Administrator
responsibilities: Provided first‑level support for hardware and software problems.
Installed, maintained, and upgraded desktop workstations.
Configured routers, switches, and wireless access points.
Administered web‑filtering solutions.
